title: Osseointegrated implants in the treatment of the edentulous jaw. Experience from a 10-year period
authors: Brånemark PI, Hansson BO, Adell R, et al
journal: Scand J Plast Reconstr Surg Suppl
citation: Brånemark PI, Hansson BO, Adell R, et al. Osseointegrated implants in the treatment of the edentulous jaw. Experience from a 10-year period. Scand J Plast Reconstr Surg Suppl. 1977;16:1-132.
abstract: Reports a decade of clinical experience with titanium implants anchored directly in bone in edentulous jaws, establishing the clinical concept of osseointegration.

title: Osseointegrated titanium implants. Requirements for ensuring a long-lasting, direct bone-to-implant anchorage in man
authors: Albrektsson T, Brånemark PI, Hansson HA, Lindström J
citation: Albrektsson T, Brånemark PI, Hansson HA, Lindström J. Osseointegrated titanium implants. Requirements for ensuring a long-lasting, direct bone-to-implant anchorage in man. Acta Orthop Scand. 1981;52(2):155-70.
abstract: Sets out the factors governing osseointegration — implant material, design, surface, bone status, surgical technique and loading conditions.

title: Reduction of residual ridges: a major oral disease entity
authors: Atwood DA
citation: Atwood DA. Reduction of residual ridges: a major oral disease entity. J Prosthet Dent. 1971;26(3):266-79.
abstract: Describes residual ridge resorption as a chronic, progressive, irreversible and cumulative disease and classifies its anatomic, metabolic, functional and prosthetic factors.

title: The continuing reduction of the residual alveolar ridges in complete denture wearers: a mixed-longitudinal study covering 25 years
authors: Tallgren A
citation: Tallgren A. The continuing reduction of the residual alveolar ridges in complete denture wearers: a mixed-longitudinal study covering 25 years. J Prosthet Dent. 1972;27(2):120-32.
abstract: Follows complete denture wearers over 25 years, showing continuing ridge reduction that is markedly greater in the mandible than the maxilla.

title: Bone healing and soft tissue contour changes following single-tooth extraction: a clinical and radiographic 12-month prospective study
authors: Schropp L, Wenzel A, Kostopoulos L, Karring T
citation: Schropp L, Wenzel A, Kostopoulos L, Karring T. Bone healing and soft tissue contour changes following single-tooth extraction: a clinical and radiographic 12-month prospective study. Int J Periodontics Restorative Dent. 2003;23(4):313-23.
abstract: Measures alveolar ridge width and socket bone fill after single-tooth extraction over 12 months; most dimensional change occurred in the first three months.

title: Dimensional ridge alterations following tooth extraction. An experimental study in the dog
authors: Araújo MG, Lindhe J
citation: Araújo MG, Lindhe J. Dimensional ridge alterations following tooth extraction. An experimental study in the dog. J Clin Periodontol. 2005;32(2):212-8.
abstract: Shows that bundle bone is resorbed after extraction, with greater vertical loss of the thin buccal wall than the lingual wall.

title: Bone "mass" and the "mechanostat": a proposal
authors: Frost HM
citation: Frost HM. Bone "mass" and the "mechanostat": a proposal. Anat Rec. 1987;219(1):1-9.
abstract: Proposes that bone mass is regulated by mechanical strain thresholds that switch between modeling and disuse-mode remodeling.

title: Osteoprotegerin ligand is a cytokine that regulates osteoclast differentiation and activation
authors: Lacey DL, Timms E, Tan HL, et al
citation: Lacey DL, Timms E, Tan HL, et al. Osteoprotegerin ligand is a cytokine that regulates osteoclast differentiation and activation. Cell. 1998;93(2):165-76.
abstract: Identifies the ligand for osteoprotegerin (RANKL) as the key cytokine driving osteoclast differentiation and activation.

title: Osteoprotegerin: a novel secreted protein involved in the regulation of bone density
authors: Simonet WS, Lacey DL, Dunstan CR, et al
citation: Simonet WS, Lacey DL, Dunstan CR, et al. Osteoprotegerin: a novel secreted protein involved in the regulation of bone density. Cell. 1997;89(2):309-19.
abstract: Describes osteoprotegerin, a secreted decoy receptor that inhibits osteoclastogenesis and increases bone density in animal models.

title: Cloning and characterization of an extracellular Ca2+-sensing receptor from bovine parathyroid
authors: Brown EM, Gamba G, Riccardi D, et al
citation: Brown EM, Gamba G, Riccardi D, et al. Cloning and characterization of an extracellular Ca2+-sensing receptor from bovine parathyroid. Nature. 1993;366(6455):575-80.
abstract: Clones the G-protein–coupled calcium-sensing receptor that lets parathyroid cells detect extracellular calcium and regulate PTH secretion.

title: Vitamin D deficiency
authors: Holick MF
citation: Holick MF. Vitamin D deficiency. N Engl J Med. 2007;357(3):266-81.
abstract: Reviews vitamin D sources, metabolism and the skeletal and extra-skeletal consequences of deficiency, with guidance on assessment and treatment.

title: FGF-23 is a potent regulator of vitamin D metabolism and phosphate homeostasis
authors: Shimada T, Hasegawa H, Yamazaki Y, et al
citation: Shimada T, Hasegawa H, Yamazaki Y, et al. FGF-23 is a potent regulator of vitamin D metabolism and phosphate homeostasis. J Bone Miner Res. 2004;19(3):429-35.
abstract: Demonstrates that FGF23 reduces serum phosphate and suppresses renal 1α-hydroxylase, linking phosphate regulation to vitamin D metabolism.

title: Pamidronate (Aredia) and zoledronate (Zometa) induced avascular necrosis of the jaws: a growing epidemic
authors: Marx RE
citation: Marx RE. Pamidronate (Aredia) and zoledronate (Zometa) induced avascular necrosis of the jaws: a growing epidemic. J Oral Maxillofac Surg. 2003;61(9):1115-7.
abstract: Early report of exposed necrotic jaw bone in patients receiving intravenous bisphosphonates, alerting clinicians to a new complication.

title: American Association of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons position paper on medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw — 2014 update
authors: Ruggiero SL, Dodson TB, Fantasia J, et al
citation: Ruggiero SL, Dodson TB, Fantasia J, et al. American Association of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons position paper on medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw — 2014 update. J Oral Maxillofac Surg. 2014;72(10):1938-56.
abstract: Updates terminology to medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw, with staging, risk estimates and management strategies for patients on antiresorptive and antiangiogenic drugs.

title: Understanding peri-implant endosseous healing
authors: Davies JE
citation: Davies JE. Understanding peri-implant endosseous healing. J Dent Educ. 2003;67(8):932-49.
abstract: Explains peri-implant healing as osteoconduction, de novo bone formation and remodeling, and contrasts contact and distance osteogenesis.

title: Bioceramics: from concept to clinic
authors: Hench LL
citation: Hench LL. Bioceramics: from concept to clinic. J Am Ceram Soc. 1991;74(7):1487-510.
abstract: Classifies bioceramics as nearly inert, porous, bioactive and resorbable, and reviews their clinical applications including calcium-phosphate materials.

title: Staging and grading of periodontitis: framework and proposal of a new classification and case definition
authors: Tonetti MS, Greenwell H, Kornman KS
citation: Tonetti MS, Greenwell H, Kornman KS. Staging and grading of periodontitis: framework and proposal of a new classification and case definition. J Periodontol. 2018;89 Suppl 1:S159-72.
abstract: Introduces the stage-and-grade framework for periodontitis from the 2017 World Workshop.

title: Experimental gingivitis in man
authors: Löe H, Theilade E, Jensen SB
citation: Löe H, Theilade E, Jensen SB. Experimental gingivitis in man. J Periodontol. 1965;36:177-87.
abstract: Shows that withdrawing oral hygiene leads to plaque accumulation and gingivitis, which resolves when hygiene is restored.

title: The effects of surgical exposures of dental pulps in germ-free and conventional laboratory rats
authors: Kakehashi S, Stanley HR, Fitzgerald RJ
journal: Oral Surg Oral Med Oral Pathol
citation: Kakehashi S, Stanley HR, Fitzgerald RJ. The effects of surgical exposures of dental pulps in germ-free and conventional laboratory rats. Oral Surg Oral Med Oral Pathol. 1965;20:340-9.
abstract: Demonstrates that bacteria are required for pulpal and periapical pathology after pulp exposure.

title: Classification of malocclusion
authors: Angle EH
citation: Angle EH. Classification of malocclusion. Dental Cosmos. 1899;41:248-64.
abstract: Introduces the molar-relationship classification of malocclusion still used in orthodontics today.
